library_name: Destiny Core Jedi and Force Talents
notes: Detailed, paraphrased Core Rulebook Jedi heroic-class and universal Force talent reference.

rules.name: Adept Negotiator
rules.description: Use reason and Force-guided persuasion to move an enemy down the condition track.

mechanics.target: One Intelligence 3+ enemy able to see, hear, and understand you.
mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. Will; a higher-level target gains +5 Will.
mechanics.effect: Move target -1 condition step. At the bottom it remains conscious but cannot attack you or allies.
mechanics.duration: Bottom-track pacification lasts through encounter unless your side attacks it or one of its allies first.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; affects a vehicle occupant such as commander, not the vehicle.

rules.name: Force Persuasion
rules.description: Substitute Use the Force for Persuasion.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Persuasion when making or rerolling Persuasion checks.

rules.name: Master Negotiator
rules.description: A successful Adept Negotiator use moves the target two condition steps.

mechanics.effect: Move the target -2 condition steps total instead of -1.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; still affects a vehicle character rather than the vehicle.

rules.name: Skilled Advisor
rules.description: Spend a round advising an ally to grant a large skill bonus.

mechanics.target: One willing ally able to hear and understand you.
mechanics.effect: Grant +5 on the ally's next skill check; spend a Force Point to make it +10.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; cannot advise yourself.

rules.name: Acrobatic Recovery
rules.description: Stay standing when an effect would knock you prone.

mechanics.trigger: An effect would make you fall prone.
mechanics.effect: On success, remain standing.

rules.name: Battle Meditation
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to coordinate nearby allies' attacks.

mechanics.target: You and allies within 6 squares when activated.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 insight on attack rolls.
mechanics.duration: Rest of encounter while an ally remains within 6 squares and you remain conscious and alive.
mechanics.special: Mind-affecting; at starship scale affects allied gunners within 6 squares.

rules.name: Elusive Target
rules.description: Ranged attackers suffer an additional penalty while you are engaged in melee.

mechanics.trigger: You are fighting one or more opponents in melee.
mechanics.effect: Other opponents take -5 on ranged attacks against you.
mechanics.special: Stacks with the normal -5 penalty for firing into melee, for -10 total when both apply.

rules.name: Force Intuition
rules.description: Use Use the Force in place of Initiative.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Initiative when making or rerolling Initiative checks.
mechanics.special: As pilot, may determine a starship's Initiative this way.

rules.name: Resilience
rules.description: Spend a full round recovering two condition steps.

mechanics.effect: Move +2 steps toward normal on the condition track.
mechanics.special: Persistent-condition restrictions still apply.

rules.name: Clear Mind
rules.description: Reroll attempts to hide your presence from other Force-users.

mechanics.trigger: Make an opposed Use the Force check to avoid detection by another Force-user.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Dark Side Scourge
rules.description: Deal additional melee damage to known dark-side creatures.

mechanics.target: A creature you know has Dark Side Score 1+.
mechanics.effect: Add your Charisma bonus, minimum +1, to melee damage against it.
mechanics.special: You must be aware of the target's dark-side status.

rules.name: Dark Side Sense
rules.description: Reroll checks to sense dark-side characters.

mechanics.trigger: Make Use the Force to sense the presence and relative location of characters with Dark Side Score 1+.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Force Haze
rules.description: Hide yourself and allies behind a Force illusion.

mechanics.target: Up to your Jedi class level in creatures within line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will of each opponent who gains line of sight to a hidden creature.
mechanics.effect: On success, all hidden creatures have total concealment against that opponent.
mechanics.duration: Up to 1 minute; ends immediately if anyone hidden by it attacks.
mechanics.special: May hide one occupied vehicle if its size penalty is no greater than your heroic level.

rules.name: Resist the Dark Side
rules.description: Gain strong defenses against dark-side powers and fully corrupted Force-users.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 Force bonus to all Defenses against powers with the dark-side descriptor and powers used by a Force-user whose Dark Side Score equals Wisdom.

rules.name: Deflect
rules.description: React with an ignited lightsaber to negate ranged attacks.

mechanics.trigger: You are aware of a ranged attack and not flat-footed.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. triggering attack roll; cumulative -5 for every Block or Deflect use since start of your last turn.
mechanics.effect: Negate a normal ranged attack. Against autofire or Force lightning, success means half damage if hit and none if missed.
mechanics.special: Requires drawn, ignited lightsaber. Force Point allows protection of an adjacent character. No effect on other area attacks, or Colossal-frigate+ vehicle attacks unless point-defense.

rules.name: Lightsaber Defense
rules.description: Use an ignited lightsaber to increase Reflex Defense.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 deflection to Reflex Defense per selection.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: Requires drawn, ignited lightsaber and awareness; no benefit while flat-footed. Repeatable to maximum +3.

rules.name: Lightsaber Throw
rules.description: Throw a lightsaber proficiently and pull it back with the Force.

mechanics.use: Standard action to throw; swift action to retrieve.
mechanics.check: If target was within 6 squares, Use the Force DC 20 returns it to your hand.
mechanics.effect: Treat the lightsaber as a proficient thrown weapon using normal range penalties and normal weapon damage.
mechanics.special: Without this talent, a thrown lightsaber is an improvised weapon.

rules.name: Redirect Shot
rules.description: Redirect one successfully deflected blaster bolt toward another target.

mechanics.use: Immediate ranged attack, once per round.
mechanics.trigger: You successfully Deflect a single blaster bolt.
mechanics.target: Another target in line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Make a ranged attack with normal range penalties measured from you; on hit deal the original weapon's normal damage.
mechanics.special: Cannot redirect autofire barrages or non-blaster projectiles.

rules.name: Weapon Specialization (Lightsabers)
rules.description: Deal additional melee damage with lightsabers.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 on melee damage rolls with lightsabers.

rules.name: Disciplined Strike
rules.description: Exclude allies or other targets from your area Force powers.

mechanics.trigger: Activate a Force power with an area effect.
mechanics.effect: Exclude a number of targets from the power equal to Wisdom modifier, minimum 1.

rules.name: Telekinetic Power
rules.description: A natural 20 with a telekinetic power lets you use it again immediately.

mechanics.trigger: Roll natural 20 on Use the Force to activate a telekinetic Force power.
mechanics.effect: Immediately use that same power again as a free action against any eligible target.

rules.name: Telekinetic Savant
rules.description: Recover an expended telekinetic Force power without a Force Point.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per encounter per selection.
mechanics.effect: Return one spent telekinetic Force power to your active suite without spending a Force Point.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for another use each encounter.

rules.name: Damage Reduction 10
rules.description: Spend a Force Point for temporary Damage Reduction.

mechanics.effect: Gain DR 10.

rules.name: Equilibrium
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to clear debilitating conditions and return to normal.

mechanics.effect: Remove all debilitating conditions affecting you and return to your normal state.
mechanics.special: GM adjudicates conditions whose own rules expressly prevent removal.

rules.name: Force Focus
rules.description: Regain a spent Force power through concentration.

mechanics.effect: On success, return one spent Force power of your choice to your active suite.

rules.name: Force Recovery
rules.description: Second wind heals additional hit points based on remaining Force Points.

mechanics.effect: Regain an additional 1d6 hit points per Force Point you currently possess, maximum 10d6.
mechanics.special: Does not spend those Force Points.

rules.name: Force Perception
rules.description: Use Use the Force for major Perception applications and count as trained in Perception.

mechanics.effect: Use Use the Force instead of Perception to avoid surprise, notice enemies, sense deception, or sense influence; count as trained in Perception.
mechanics.special: A permitted Perception reroll may reroll the substituted Use the Force check under the same limits.

rules.name: Force Pilot
rules.description: Use Use the Force instead of Pilot.

mechanics.effect: Use your Use the Force modifier instead of Pilot when making or rerolling Pilot checks.

rules.name: Foresight
rules.description: Spend a Force Point to reroll Initiative and keep the better result.

mechanics.effect: Reroll and keep the better result.
mechanics.special: If the reroll is a natural 20, immediately regain the Force Point spent.

rules.name: Gauge Force Potential
rules.description: Determine another creature's basic Force capabilities.

mechanics.target: One creature in line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: Learn whether it has Force Sensitivity, how many Force powers it knows, and its current Force Point total; not which powers.

rules.name: Visions
rules.description: Use Farseeing to view a target's past or possible future.

mechanics.effect: View the target up to 1 year per character level into its past or future rather than present circumstances.
mechanics.special: Future information is mutable if later choices alter events.

rules.name: Dark Presence
rules.description: Grant nearby allies a Force bonus to all Defenses.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 Force bonus to all Defenses.
mechanics.duration: Until encounter end while within range and while you remain conscious and alive.

rules.name: Power of the Dark Side
rules.description: Increase a Force Point's attack bonus die at the cost of corruption.

mechanics.trigger: Spend a Force Point to modify an attack roll.
mechanics.effect: Roll one additional Force die and apply the best single die result.

rules.name: Revenge
rules.description: An equal- or higher-level ally falling fuels your attacks.

mechanics.trigger: An ally of your level or higher is killed or reduced to 0 hit points in your line of sight.
mechanics.effect: Gain +2 Force bonus on attack and damage rolls.
mechanics.special: Multiple triggers do not stack.

rules.name: Swift Power
rules.description: Use one standard- or move-action Force power as a swift action.

mechanics.effect: Activate a Force power that normally requires a standard or move action as a swift action.
